rule.description: A method reads at least two load-context attributes of a non-receiver parameter and strictly more such attributes than of its own receiver; method-call function attributes and assignment-target writes are excluded. The canonical repair relocates the envious decision onto the data-owning object where that owner is in-repo, and inlines it back into its single call site where the envied owner is an external/stdlib type.
rule.detected_relation: connector method -> foreign object (probe result / destination / option namespace) attribute reads
rule.why_this_is_the_smell: Feature envy: a decision lives on the xxh connector but is more interested in another object's data than in the receiver's own state, so the data locality is mislaid.

checks.description: xxh connector methods that branch on a foreign probe-result, destination, or option object's attributes instead of asking that object.
checks.detected_relation: xxh method reads >= 2 attributes of a non-receiver parameter (host_info / url / opt) and strictly more than self
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The probe result, parsed destination, and option namespace own the data these methods read; the connector is acting as a data-less dispatcher over their fields.

matches.evidence: reads host_info.home_realpath (x2) and host_info.version (x2): 4 foreign reads vs self.host_xxh_home (1); self.eeprint call expressions excluded.
reads host_info.home_writable, host_info.parent_home_writable, host_info.scp, host_info.rsync: 4 foreign reads vs self.local (1).
reads opt.install, opt.install_force, opt.install_force_full: 3 foreign reads (plus host_info.version/shell_exists) vs self.quiet (1).
reads url.port (x2) and url.username (x2): 4 foreign reads (assignment of opt.ssh_port/ssh_login excluded) vs self.hostname (1).

excluded.note: pre-existing envious helper present on the clean tree before injection; not part of this task's coverage and filtered out of the verdict by the canonical method-name scope.
